ns2:course.label: Design Communications I
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of visual communication in the design process and presentation for landscape architecture. Includes freehand and constructed drawing, color, media, and models. Open to Landscape Architecture majors only. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in LA 233.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Open to Landscape Architecture majors only. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in LA 233.
